messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} Re: [distance-sampling] Soap film smoothing checking with autocrunch not working.
parts:
OK Adrian

Good news, I was able to duplicate the error arising when sourcing autocrunch.R .

Somehow, the autocrunch.R file you were trying to source was not a file filled with R code, but rather a file filled with HTML code that contained the R code.  Have another look at the autocrunch.R file you attached to your most recent email. The clue to that was the error stating "unexpected '<'"  The '<' symbol is the in the seventh line of the file.

Get a proper file of R code in autocrunch.R  and all will work as expected.
